decision.explanation: Document d1 explicitly states that 'Novak Djokovic finished the year as world No. 1 for the fifth time in his career,' directly answering the question about the men's year-end No. 1 in tennis in 2019. Document d2 lists R. Nadal as rank 1 in the ATP rankings for 2019, but this appears to be a snapshot ranking (not year-end) and conflicts with the explicit year-end statement in d1. Document d3 incorrectly attributes the year-end No. 1 status to Rafael Nadal, contradicting d1. Only Novak Djokovic is unambiguously supported by the original context as the correct year-end No. 1 in 2019.
